# Ventrix

> Ventrix is web-based tool and stock tracking software for stores, workshops, tool rooms, schools and field crews. It records who has checked-out equipment, tracks consumable stock and counts, and supports everyday work offline.

Ventrix is built by Ventrix and is available at https://vntrx-site.vercel.app. The application is at https://vntrx.vercel.app.

## What it does

- Check tools and equipment out to a person, team, department or job; track due dates, overdue items and partial returns.
- Track consumables separately from reusable assets, with stock minimums, reorder quantities and low-stock alerts.
- Run shelf-based stock counts, record reasons for differences and optionally require supervisor approval.
- Continue searching, checking items out and returning them while offline; queued actions sync when the connection returns.
- Set staff roles, approval policies and optional photo proof; review activity and export reports as CSV.

## Pricing

One plan costs NGN 14,999 per organization per month. See https://ventrix.app/pricing for current inclusions and details.

## Audience

Ventrix is intended for small stores, tool rooms, workshops, schools and labs, contractors, and field crews that need to track shared equipment and consumable stock.
